# Injury risk

<!-- Generated by scripts/draft-board/injury_risk.py. Do not hand-edit. -->

Research as of 2026-09-02. 26 players — 3 LOW, 15 MED, 8 HIGH, 0 ?.

Tiers are computed, not typed: each player's cited injury history is scored by the rubric in `injury_risk.py` and cut at fixed thresholds (≥6 HIGH, 3–5 MED, ≤2 LOW). Recent seasons weigh more: 2025-26 ×1, 2024-25 ×0.55, 2023-24 ×0.3, 2022-23 ×0.15. `?` means the research found nothing to go on, not that the player is clean.

The board scales nothing by games played (ADR-0017). This is context for a judgement call, not a multiplier.
